resources.string: One picture on both screens: the cover shows the right half of the unfolded one, and the left half frosts in on every unfold — on the lock screen and under any Home.
Allows Duo Launcher’s Home screen gestures to open the system notifications and Quick Settings panels. It does not read screen content or observe activity in other apps.
Shows ongoing notifications (timers, navigation, calls, media) as a Live Updates island in the launcher’s rail. Duo Launcher does not store or forward notification content.
